name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria: evidence from Shio records (Shio does not certify)
description: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria: evidence from Shio records (Shio does not certify). From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised points of focus 2022); an audit by a qualified firm is required

controls.title: Control environment
controls.requirement: Control environment: integrity and ethics, board oversight, structure, competence and accountability are attested.

controls.title: Information and communication
controls.requirement: Information and communication: internal and external communication of objectives and responsibilities.

controls.title: Risk assessment
controls.requirement: Risk assessment: objectives, risks (the risk register), fraud risk and significant change are assessed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.requirement: Monitoring activities: controls are evaluated and deficiencies reported (monitors, control evidence report).

controls.title: Control activities are selected
controls.requirement: Control activities are selected, developed and deployed through policies.

controls.title: Logical access
controls.requirement: Logical access: unique identities and least privilege for agents and callers.

controls.title: Transmission and boundary protection
controls.requirement: Transmission and boundary protection: TLS endpoints; data leaves only through the gate.

controls.title: Unauthorised or malicious software is prevented: pinned dependencies
controls.requirement: Unauthorised or malicious software is prevented: pinned dependencies, signed manifests.

controls.title: System operations
controls.requirement: System operations: anomalies and drift are detected and evaluated.

controls.title: Incidents are evaluated
controls.requirement: Incidents are evaluated, responded to and recovered from, as signed records.

controls.title: Change management
controls.requirement: Change management: changes to models, prompts, tools and policies are authorised, tested and recorded.

controls.title: Risk mitigation
controls.requirement: Risk mitigation, including vendors and business partners.

controls.title: Availability
controls.requirement: Availability: capacity, backup and recovery are planned and tested.

controls.title: Confidentiality
controls.requirement: Confidentiality: confidential information is identified, protected and disposed of (vault, erasure).

controls.title: Processing integrity
controls.requirement: Processing integrity: inputs, processing and outputs are complete, accurate and recorded.

controls.title: Privacy
controls.requirement: Privacy: notice, choice, collection, use, access, disclosure, quality and monitoring are attested.
